description: A pipeline: its steps, and what starts it. Generated from the parser; `launchway validate` is the judge.

image.description: The container image the step's script runs in.

containers.description: Named images that steps run in, and services that run beside them.

defaults.description: What every script step takes unless it says otherwise: image, container, env, timeout, retry, cache.

cache.description: Directories kept between runs, restored before the step and saved after it.

container.description: A named container from containers: that the step runs in.

image.description: The container image the step's script runs in.

retry.description: Extra attempts after a failure, or { times, wait, backoff, on }.

timeout.description: How long one attempt may run, such as 10m.

inputs.description: Values a run is started with.

lane.description: Which runs of the project may go at the same time.

libraries.description: Shared libraries a pipeline uses templates from; launchway/ needs no entry.

on.description: What starts a run: push, pull_request, schedule, webhook.

pipeline.description: The pipeline's name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

resources.description: CPU and memory of the step: { cpu, cpu_limit, memory, memory_limit }. On a step that uses a template: the default of every stage that runs a script.

runner.description: Which runners may run the steps: a pool, labels or both.

stages.description: On a step that uses a template: settings of single stages by name, such as { test: { resources: { memory: 6Gi }, services: [db] } }.

additionalProperties.description: One step. The keys that apply depend on kind; the parser says which do not.

add.description: With for_each: whole combinations to add outside the lists.

artifacts.description: Sets of files the step keeps for download and for later steps.

cache.description: Directories kept between runs, restored before the step and saved after it.

container.description: A named container from containers: that the step runs in.

continue_for.description: With for_each: combinations that may fail without failing the run.

description.description: One line saying what the step is for.

exclude.description: With for_each: combinations to leave out.

fail_fast.description: With for_each: stop the other combinations once one fails (default true).

fetch.description: Artifacts of earlier steps to put in the workspace first.

for_each.description: Repeat the step once for each combination of the lists (a matrix); see exclude, add, max_parallel, fail_fast, continue_for.

image.description: The container image the step's script runs in.

inputs.description: Values a run is started with.

kind.description: What the step is: omit for a step that runs a script.

max_parallel.description: With for_each: how many combinations may be queued or running at once.

needs.description: The steps that must succeed first; a step that uses for_each or a template is waited for as a whole.

reports.description: Files the step writes that Launchway reads: tests, coverage, findings, sbom.

resources.description: CPU and memory of the step: { cpu, cpu_limit, memory, memory_limit }. On a step that uses a template: the default of every stage that runs a script.

retry.description: Extra attempts after a failure, or { times, wait, backoff, on }.

runner.description: Which runners may run the steps: a pool, labels or both.

secrets.description: Variables whose values a runner looks up from a secret store.

services.description: The service containers that run beside this step ([] for none, all for every one); a step that says nothing starts them all.

stages.description: On a step that uses a template: settings of single stages by name, such as { test: { resources: { memory: 6Gi }, services: [db] } }.

timeout.description: How long one attempt may run, such as 10m.

uses.description: A template or custom step to use in place of this step: library/template, such as launchway/go-service, library/step, or ./steps/name for a custom step of this repository.

when.description: Conditions for the step to run: branch, tag, input, output, upstream.

with.description: The values of the template's parameters.

supersede.description: A new run of a push or pull request cancels older runs of the same ref still going.

timeout.description: How long one attempt may run, such as 10m.

uses.description: A template or custom step to use in place of this step: library/template, such as launchway/go-service, library/step, or ./steps/name for a custom step of this repository.

with.description: The values of the template's parameters.

workspace.description: Paths a runner that carries the workspace from step to step leaves out of it: workspace: { exclude: [node_modules] }.
